items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: We'd been out there, and been in that town two or three times. And Lamar Wright, I relied on him to say where I was living.

ctx.x: I always had compassion for new guys that came in the band. And I heard you play, because we brought the book out on you, and you played all them darn things, and you was a new man, and you didn't know the road like the rest of us... We'd been out there, and been in that town two or three times. And Lamar Wright, I relied on him to say where I was living. I didn't worry about it.
